title: Love! And they’re good quality.
text: Love! And they’re good quality.. They aren’t lined, but we have blinds under them so that didn’t matter as far as energy efficiency. They are pretty thick, so without blinds or another layer, I’m betting they’d hold a lot of heat and actually make the room warmer in the summer. So true to color though and really nice.
